title: Unpackable Nether Quartz
description: This data pack allows you to unpack a block of quartz into 4 nether quartz.
body:
**Block of Quartz to Quartz**

Allows players to revert a block of nether quartz back into quartz. Each block gives 4 pieces of nether quartz.

Place this in your worlds data pack folder for it to work.

THIS HAS NOT BEEN TESTED ON EARLIER VERSIONS, BUT IT MAY WORK!
